newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson Tech sees Q1 EPS $1.50-$1.90.
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson Tech sees Q1 EPS $1.50-$1.90.

text.p: Hutchinson Technology Inc said Tuesday its fiscal first quarter (ending December 29) earnings will range from $1.50 to $1.90 per share on net sales of $104 to $109 million.
For the year-ago first quarter Hutchinson earned $2.9 million, or $0.51 a share, including a $0.69 per share charge, on net sales of $83.3 million.
Hutchinson said demand for suspension assemblies rose during the fiscal first half after declining in the fiscal 1996 fourth quarter.

"Demand has been strong for all suspension types and the manufacturing capacity we added over the past year has enabled us to keep pace with customer requirements," said Wayne Fortun, Hutchinson chief executive officer.
Hutchinson supplies suspension assemblies for disk drives.
